_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "generation" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" > 0), "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("name") > 0), "region_name" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "species" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" > 0), "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("name") > 0), "generation_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES generation (id), "evolution_chain_id" INTEGER NULL CHECK("evolution_chain_id" > 0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pokemon" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" > 0), "national_number" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("national_number" > 0), "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("name") > 0), "image_url" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "species_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES species (id), "height" INTEGER NULL CHECK("height" >= 0), "weight" INTEGER NULL CHECK("weight" >= 0), "base_stat_total" INTEGER NULL CHECK("base_stat_total" >= 0), "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), "shiny_image_url" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "type" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" > 0), "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("name") > 0) UNIQUE, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pokemon_type" ("pokemon_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES pokemon (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "type_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES type (id), "slot" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("slot" BETWEEN 1 AND 2), PRIMARY KEY ("pokemon_id", "type_id"), UNIQUE ("pokemon_id", "slot"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "favorite" ("pokemon_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES pokemon (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("pokemon_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_metadata" ("resource_key" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("resource_key") > 0), "next_offset" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("next_offset" >= 0), "total_count" INTEGER NULL CHECK("total_count" >= 0), "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'idle' CHECK("status" IN ('idle', 'syncing', 'success', 'failed')), "last_success_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "is_complete" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_complete" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("resource_key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stat" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" > 0), "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("name") > 0) UNIQUE, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pokemon_stat" ("pokemon_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES pokemon (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "stat_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES stat (id), "base_value" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("base_value" >= 0), PRIMARY KEY ("pokemon_id", "stat_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ability" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" > 0), "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("name") > 0), "effect_summary" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pokemon_ability" ("pokemon_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES pokemon (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "ability_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES ability (id), "slot" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("slot" BETWEEN 1 AND 3), "is_hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_hidden" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("pokemon_id", "ability_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "move" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" > 0), "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("name") > 0), "type_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES type (id), "power" INTEGER NULL CHECK("power" >= 0), "accuracy" INTEGER NULL CHECK("accuracy" BETWEEN 0 AND 100), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "version_group" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" > 0), "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("name") > 0) UNIQUE, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("sort_order" >= 0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pokemon_move" ("pokemon_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES pokemon (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "move_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES move (id), "version_group_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES version_group (id), "learn_method" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("learn_method") > 0), "level_learned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("level_learned" >= 0), PRIMARY KEY ("pokemon_id", "move_id", "version_group_id", "learn_method", "level_learned"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "egg_group" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" > 0), "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("name") > 0) UNIQUE, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "species_egg_group" ("species_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES species (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "egg_group_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES egg_group (id), PRIMARY KEY ("species_id", "egg_group_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "evolution" ("from_species_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES species (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "to_species_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES species (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "trigger" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("trigger") > 0), "min_level" INTEGER NULL CHECK("min_level" > 0), "item_name" TEXT NULL, "min_happiness" INTEGER NULL CHECK("min_happiness" >= 0), "time_of_day" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("from_species_id", "to_species_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "type_efficacy" ("attacker_type_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES type (id), "defender_type_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES type (id), "damage_factor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("damage_factor" IN (0, 50, 100, 200)), PRIMARY KEY ("attacker_type_id", "defender_type_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trivia_result" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "score" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("score" >= 0), "correct_answers" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("correct_answers" >= 0), "total_questions" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("total_questions" > 0), "played_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trivia_answer" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "trivia_result_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES trivia_result (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "pokemon_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES pokemon (id), "correct" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("correct" IN (0, 1)), "answered_in_ms" INTEGER NULL CHECK("answered_in_ms" >= 0));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "achievement" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("key") > 0), "unlocked_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_setting" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("key") > 0), "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "image_cache" ("url" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("url") > 0), "local_path" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("local_path") > 0) UNIQUE, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("size_bytes" >= 0), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_accessed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("url"));
CREATE INDEX pokemon_national_order ON pokemon (national_number, id)
CREATE INDEX pokemon_name ON pokemon (name)
CREATE INDEX pokemon_species_lookup ON pokemon (species_id)
CREATE INDEX pokemon_stat_total_order ON pokemon (base_stat_total, id)
CREATE INDEX pokemon_type_by_type ON pokemon_type (type_id, pokemon_id)
CREATE INDEX favorite_creation_order ON favorite (created_at, pokemon_id)
CREATE INDEX species_generation ON species (generation_id, id)
CREATE INDEX pokemon_ability_by_ability ON pokemon_ability (ability_id)
CREATE INDEX pokemon_move_by_version ON pokemon_move (pokemon_id, version_group_id, learn_method)
CREATE INDEX evolution_to_species ON evolution (to_species_id)
CREATE INDEX trivia_result_ranking ON trivia_result (score, played_at)
CREATE INDEX trivia_answer_by_result ON trivia_answer (trivia_result_id)
CREATE INDEX image_cache_lru ON image_cache (last_accessed_at)
